business: Coast, an AI content workspace for social media agencies
target: Freelance social media managers and small social media agencies (1 to 10 people) in Europe who write content for 3 to 30 client brands every week
where: Online, mainly EU (Lithuania/Baltics and wider Europe); prices in euros

segments.name: Owner of a 2-5 person agency, 8-20 clients
Owner or lead at a 6-10 person agency, 20+ clients

behaviours.name: Already uses ChatGPT or Claude daily
behaviours.how: Has a saved prompt or a project per client in a general AI assistant and pays about 20 a month for it.

behaviours.name: Tool-stack loyalist
behaviours.how: Lives in a scheduler (Metricool, Buffer, SocialBee, Planable) and only adds tools that plug into it.

behaviours.name: Trial hopper
behaviours.how: Signs up for every new AI tool, rarely pays past the first month.

behaviours.name: Cost cutter
behaviours.how: Margins are thin; every subscription is reviewed monthly and cancelled if not used weekly.

behaviours.name: Quality-first
behaviours.how: Rewrites most AI drafts; only pays for tools whose output clients approve without edits.

behaviours.name: Writes everything by hand
behaviours.how: Distrusts AI copy for clients and uses it only for brainstorming, if at all.

objections: I already get this from ChatGPT with a saved brief per client
